tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, sidebar, dialogs. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, input wells, code blocks, inactive segments.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table rows and nav items.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary-button borders. Meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and metric values on surface and bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, table headers, comparison values.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper text, placeholders. Still 5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink: logo mark, sidebar active indicator, cover blocks. In dark it flips to a pale steel so the mark stays visible.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal Teal. Primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected states, chart series 1. One primary action per page.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav item ground, accent badges.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-subtle; link text on bg.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: A change in the metric's good direction (more conversions, lower CPA). Always paired with an arrow and sign.

tokens.name: good-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of good delta badges and success toasts; good text on it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: A change in the metric's bad direction, critical alerts, failed changes, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: bad-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of bad delta badges and critical alert rows; bad text on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, maturing-data markers, budget pacing over the soft threshold.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of warning banners and pending-approval badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices, external-change badges, neutral deltas that still need attention.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of info banners and info badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 and the focus series. Teal.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Blue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Amber; 3.6:1 on surface, so use it for marks, never for text.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Plum.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Coral. Not used next to bad in the same chart.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 and 'Other'. Slate.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the zero line's lighter siblings.

tokens.name: chart-compare
tokens.usage: Compare-period series, drawn dashed behind the current period.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the mobile assistant sheet.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Steady control over your ad spend

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Card and section titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Sub-sections inside a card, builder group labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Paused 4 keywords that spent 1 840 NOK in 30 days with no conversions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Entity names, button labels, emphasized cells.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, helper text, comparison labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, chips, axis labels, table column headers.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: The value on a KPI card. Render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Rule JSON editor, IDs, GAQL snippets.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Inside components use space-1 to space-4; between cards space-4 to space-6; page gutters space-6 (desktop) and space-4 (mobile).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards on mobile, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on KPI cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, sign-in layout.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, chips, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the change review panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatar, toggle tracks.

shadow.note: Keel separates with borders first. Shadows only lift things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Sticky table header and scope bar when content scrolls under them.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, evidence popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, assistant panel.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and layout chrome.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch targets on mobile; primary actions on the mobile Approvals screen.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar icon rail.

tokens.name: scopebar-height
tokens.usage: Top scope bar on desktop and tablet.

tokens.name: assistant-width
tokens.usage: Assistant side panel on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width before side margins grow.
